title: Burstcoin Web Wallet & Decentralized Asset Exchange
summary: Zero-trust client-side browser wallet and on-chain decentralized asset exchange (DEX) interface enabling instant user onboarding with in-memory Curve25519 signing.
highlights: Zero-trust in-browser cryptography: client-side passphrase hashing via Curve25519 and SHA-256 ensuring private keys never leave local browser memory.
Decentralized Asset Exchange (DEX) orderbook interface supporting custom token issuance (BCPT) and automated profit-sharing dividends.
Eliminated cumbersome full-node synchronization requirements, drastically lowering onboarding friction for the Proof-of-Capacity cryptocurrency.
